info.title: HRM Backend API
info.description:
**Human Resource Management System Backend API**

A comprehensive REST API for managing HR operations including employee management, leave tracking, 
performance monitoring, offboarding workflows, and administrative tasks. This API serves as the 
backend for a full-featured HRM system supporting multiple user roles (Employee, Manager, HR).

**Authentication:** All endpoints (except login, register, and debug) require Bearer token authentication.
Obtain a token by calling the `/api/login` endpoint.

**Key Features:**
- Employee self-service portal
- Leave management and approval workflows  
- HR chatbot and FAQ system
- Resume management and candidate matching
- Offboarding automation
- Birthday tracking and event management
- Notification and announcement system
- Analytics and reporting
